pages.title: Where to look
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Collapsed Kingdom.

pages.title: Locator search
pages.text: Use this encounter’s locator in the Overworld. It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat.

pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: The current setting blocks arrows; direct damage attributed to thrown potions and area-effect clouds is rejected separately. Sleep and a special transition state block normal damage. Let a transformation finish before returning to melee attacks.

pages.title: Starting combat
pages.text: Waiting for Start on a dedicated server is separate preparation protection. Start combat from the boss encounter menu. In singleplayer use native awakening; server parties and JEM Raid are unavailable there.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Corrupted Soul, Soul Great Sword. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Campaign
pages.text: In an active campaign this main-boss victory is linked to the Corrupted Eye. First record the branch victories: Bone Stalker, Overgrown Colossus. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.
